journey.title: Move to the next open day with the arrow key
journey.goal: From Friday 20 November, ArrowRight selects Monday 23 November, never a closed weekend day

functionalJourney.goal: A weekday can be clicked; the saved day changes to it

guards.title: Arrow keys still move between open days
guards.goal: ArrowLeft from Friday selects Thursday, and ArrowDown selects the Thursday a week later

guards.title: Arrow keys stop at the last bookable day
guards.goal: ArrowDown reaches maxDate, and ArrowRight there keeps that day

Press ArrowRight on the last bookable day

plan.root_cause: The keyboard navigation handlers (_onKeyChange) call adjustDate directly, which does not skip dates disabled by disableDayFn, disableWeekends, minDate, or maxDate.
plan.repair_strategy: Replace the arrow key cases in _onKeyChange with calls to a new helper _adjustDateSkipDisabled that steps by the requested increment while skipping disabled dates (outside min/max, weekends, or disableDayFn) and only updates the date if an enabled date is found within bounds.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowRight and ArrowLeft will now move to the next or previous enabled weekday, preventing focus on disabled weekend days and satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order.
functional_risks: Potential infinite loop if all dates in a direction are disabled (mitigated by safety counter).
Behavior change if minDate/maxDate are set to disabled dates (should not occur in normal usage).
Week arrow keys (ArrowUp/ArrowDown) may skip multiple weeks when encountering disabled dates, but still respect min/max bounds.
The added safety counter may prematurely abort in extremely rare edge cases with many consecutive disabled dates (>100 days).
verification_requirements: ArrowUp/ArrowDown adjust by week while skipping weekends.
At minDate/maxDate boundaries, arrow keys stop at the last/first enabled date.
Existing regression guards (Arrow keys still move between open days, Arrow keys stop at the last bookable day) continue to pass.

plan.root_cause: The keyboard navigation handlers (_onKeyChange) call adjustDate directly, which does not skip dates disabled by disableDayFn, disableWeekends, minDate, or maxDate. ArrowRight from Friday 2026-11-20 moves to Saturday 2026-11-21 (disabled) instead of Monday 2026-11-23.
plan.repair_strategy: Replace the arrow key cases in _onKeyChange with calls to a new helper _adjustDateSkipDisabled that steps by the requested increment while skipping disabled dates (outside min/max, weekends, or disableDayFn) and only updates the date if an enabled date is found within bounds. Insert the helper function between _onKeyChange and _parseFieldValue.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowRight and ArrowLeft will now move to the next or previous enabled weekday, preventing focus on disabled weekend days and satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order. ArrowUp/ArrowDown adjust by week while skipping weekends. At minDate/maxDate boundaries, arrow keys stop at the last/first enabled date.
functional_risks: Potential infinite loop if all dates in a direction are disabled (mitigated by safety counter).
Behavior change if minDate/maxDate are set to disabled dates (should not occur in normal usage).
Week arrow keys (ArrowUp/ArrowDown) may skip multiple weeks when encountering disabled dates, but still respect min/max bounds.
The added safety counter may prematurely abort in extremely rare edge cases with many consecutive disabled dates (>100 days).
verification_requirements: ArrowUp/ArrowDown adjust by week while skipping weekends.
At minDate/maxDate boundaries, arrow keys stop at the last/first enabled date.
Existing regression guards (Arrow keys still move between open days, Arrow keys stop at the last bookable day) continue to pass.
